name: LCD 16x2 green (parallel, LiquidCrystal)
author: Bench Workshop
description: A 16x2 character LCD (HD44780) with green text, wired the classic parallel way: RS, E and four data pins, as in Arduino's LiquidCrystal examples. Includes LiquidCrystal.h for sketches. Needs its contrast pin (V0) set, like the real one.

parts.name: LCD 16x2 green (parallel)
parts.description: 16 pins, left to right: VSS (GND), VDD (5 V), V0 (contrast: a 10k knob between 5 V and GND, middle leg here; near 0 V = darkest text), RS, RW (to GND), E, D0-D7 (only D4-D7 in 4-bit mode), A and K (the backlight: A to 5 V, K to GND). In a sketch: #include <LiquidCrystal.h>, LiquidCrystal lcd(rs, e, d4, d5, d6, d7); lcd.begin(16, 2); lcd.print("Hello");

examples.name: Hello, LCD (LiquidCrystal)
examples.description: The LCD wired to a board as in Arduino's LiquidCrystal Hello World, with a knob for contrast. Press Run; turn the knob if the text is faint.
